title: WhatsApp assistant
subtitle: Create and manage meetings by WhatsApp message.

row.title: WhatsApp assistant
row.subtitle: Link your account to the WhatsApp bot

explainer: Link your WhatsApp number to create meetings by message. Generate a code here, then send it to the bot from WhatsApp. The code works once and expires after a few minutes.

code.expired: This code has expired. Generate a new one.

unlink.confirmBody: The bot will stop recognizing your number. You can link it again at any time.

status.unavailable: The WhatsApp assistant is not available yet. Check back soon.

error.rateLimited: You have requested too many codes today. Try again tomorrow.
